entries.title: Answers you start on a card follow you to your other computers
entries.body: When you pick answers on a card, type in its field or add notes and leave it unfinished, your other computers' windows show the same picks and words a moment later, and they are still there after a restart. Nothing is sent until you press a button or send a reply, and they go away once the card is answered.
entries.noPicture: The card looks the same in every window; what changes is that a pick made in one window appears in the other.
